objects.query: SELECT Id, Product2Id, OrderId, PricebookEntryId, Quantity, UnitPrice, ServiceDate, EndDate, Description, Scheduled_Install_Date__c, Product_Status__c, Description__c, Estimated_Release_Date__c, Invoice_Date__c, Delivery_Contact__c, Forwarding_Agent__c, Total_Cost__c, Item_Category__c, Commission_Group__c, Sales_Admin_Note__c, Profit_Center__c, Reason_for_Order__c, Material_Group__c, SAP_Order_Status__c, SAP_Order__c, Item__c, Product_Name__c, Original_Requested_Ship_Date__c, Scheduled_Ship_Date__c, Invoice__c, Billing_Type__c, Billing_Category__c, Sales_Document_Type__c, Product_Invoiced__c, Warehouse__c FROM OrderItem WHERE Order.EffectiveDate >= 2024-01-01 AND Order.EffectiveDate <= 2024-12-31 ORDER BY OrderId
